lines: Mudrā should exhibit after mentally or even from yoga; by speech by mantra-yoga by body from placement.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mudrāṃ pradarśayetpaścānmanasā vāpi yogataḥ vacasā mantrayogena vapuṣā saṃniveśataḥ
